name: Farmland
bpBasis: Sized by wheat at 100 kg an hour, 876 t a year, 241 ha at the FAO world wheat yield of 3.64 t a ha (2024, through Our World in Data); the World Bank AICD background paper (2008) takes $1,000 a ha to develop large-scale irrigation, so $241,000

name: Greenhouse
bpBasis: Sized by leafy greens at 300 kg an hour, 2,628 t a year; AeroFarms invested $42M in its Danville vertical farm (2019), which grows over 3 million lb, 1,361 t, of leafy greens a year, scaled linearly to $81M

name: Algae bioreactor

real.plant: Earthrise Nutritionals spirulina farm, Calipatria, California (DIC Corporation)
real.basis: Earthrise grows about 500 t of spirulina a year (Area Development, 2016); its staff, power and water are not published

bpBasis: Chalermthai et al. (Scientific Reports, 2023) cost a 20 ha raceway plant making about 1,000 t of spirulina powder and 1,200 t of bioplastic a year at $55.7M, scaled linearly by the spirulina to Earthrise's 500 t a year, $27.9M; the bioplastic line makes it high

name: Protein fermenter

real.plant: Solar Foods Factory 01, Vantaa, Finland (Solar Foods)
real.basis: Factory 01 is to make at most 160 t of single-cell protein a year (Solar Foods press kit), from hydrogen-oxidising bacteria rather than methanotrophs; its staff, power and water are not published

bpBasis: Solar Foods' total investment in Factory 01 is about 42 million euros, $45.5 million at the ECB's 2024 average of 1.0824 dollars a euro

name: Food plant

real.plant: Almunajem Foods factory, Third Industrial City, Jeddah (Almunajem Foods)
real.basis: Almunajem's new Jeddah factory has a capacity of 35,000 t of food a year (Food Business MEA, 2024); every ration runs at that scale; its staff, power and water are not published

bpBasis: Almunajem Foods is investing 157 million riyals, $41.88 million, in its 35,000 t a year Jeddah factory (Food Business MEA, 2024)
